lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: And what door did you go out of?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That one where the cement a stairs are.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: And that's located in proximity to what inside, is it near his bedroom, far away?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Straight across from that door? (Brendan nods “yes”)

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Where did you take her then?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Take her outside on the side of the garage and shoot her.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Take her outside of the garage and shoot her?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: On the side of it, yeah.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK, and then what do you do with her?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Then we, he puts the gun on the ground and we carry her into the fire.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: How many times did you shoot her? (pause) Tell me again, how many times did you shoot her?
